original_KO_record.question: 38.101-1-3.2가 참조하는 다른 TS Section 목록은?
original_KO_record.cypher: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.101-1'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(a:Section {sectionNumber:'3.2'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH a,rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (a)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(b:Section) RETURN b.sectionId, b.sectionTitle ORDER BY b.sectionNumber LIMIT 25
